e|have you ever been.name: have you ever been
e|have you ever been.why: 가 본 적이 있는지 물을 때는 현재완료 Have you ever been을 써요.
e|have you ever been.line: Have you ever been to a big concert?

e|it turned out.name: it turned out
e|it turned out.gloss: 그녀는 집에 열쇠를 두고 와서 가져오지 않았다.
e|it turned out.after: she forgot her keys at home.
e|it turned out.why: 나중에 드러난 결과는 과거형 It turned out으로 말해요.
e|it turned out.line: It turned out she forgot her keys at home.

e|to be honest.name: to be honest
e|to be honest.gloss: 솔직히 말해서, 나는 추운 날씨를 좋아하지 않아.
e|to be honest.after: , I do not like cold weather.
e|to be honest.why: 솔직히 말한다는 뜻은 To be honest예요.
e|to be honest.line: To be honest, I do not like cold weather.

e|the thing is.name: the thing is
e|the thing is.gloss: 문제는 내가 집에 열쇠를 두고 왔다는 거야.
e|the thing is.after: , I forgot my keys at home.
e|the thing is.why: 핵심이나 진짜 이유를 꺼낼 때는 The thing is를 써요.
e|the thing is.line: The thing is, I forgot my keys at home.

e|in the end.name: in the end
e|in the end.gloss: 결국 우리는 모두 함께 집에 갔어요.
e|in the end.why: 결국 어떻게 됐는지는 In the end로 말해요.
e|in the end.line: In the end, we all went home together.

e|it depends.name: it depends
e|it depends.gloss: 오늘 공원에 갈 수 있는지는 날씨에 따라 달라요.
e|it depends.before: Can we go to the park today?
e|it depends.why: 상황에 따라 달라진다는 말은 It depends예요.
e|it depends.line: Can we go to the park today? It depends on the weather.

e|no wonder.name: no wonder
e|no wonder.gloss: 네가 피곤해 보이는 것이 당연해, 밤새 일했으니까.
e|no wonder.after: you look tired, you worked all night.
e|no wonder.why: 이유를 들으면 당연하다는 말은 No wonder예요.
e|no wonder.line: No wonder you look tired, you worked all night.

e|make sure.name: make sure
e|make sure.why: 빠뜨리지 말고 확인하라는 말은 make sure예요.
e|make sure.line: Please make sure you lock the door.

e|figure it out.name: figure it out
e|figure it out.why: 스스로 답을 알아낸다는 말은 figure it out이에요.
e|figure it out.line: Let me try to figure it out.

e|run out of.name: run out of
e|run out of.gloss: 우리가 더 사지 않으면 우유가 다 떨어질 거야.
e|run out of.after: milk if we don't buy more.
e|run out of.why: 무엇이 다 떨어진다는 말은 run out of예요.
e|run out of.line: We will run out of milk if we don't buy more.

e|on time.name: on time
e|on time.why: 정해진 시각에 맞는다는 말은 on time이에요.
e|on time.line: The bus is never on time.

e|as soon as possible.name: as soon as possible
e|as soon as possible.gloss: 최대한 빨리 저에게 다시 전화해 주세요.
e|as soon as possible.why: 가능한 한 빨리라는 말은 as soon as possible이에요.
e|as soon as possible.line: Please call me back as soon as possible.

e|it's worth trying.name: it's worth trying
e|it's worth trying.why: 해볼 가치가 있다는 말은 worth 뒤에 동명사를 둔 it's worth trying이에요.
e|it's worth trying.line: If you are not sure, it's worth trying.

e|what do you mean.name: what do you mean
e|what do you mean.gloss: 무슨 뜻인지 설명해 줄 수 있어요?
e|what do you mean.why: 무슨 뜻이냐고 되물을 때는 What do you mean이에요.
e|what do you mean.line: What do you mean by that?

e|let me know.name: let me know
e|let me know.why: 알려 달라고 할 때는 Let me know예요.
e|let me know.line: Let me know if you need more time.

e|keep in touch.name: keep in touch
e|keep in touch.why: 앞으로도 연락하자는 말은 keep in touch예요.
e|keep in touch.line: Let’s keep in touch after the trip.

e|sort it out.name: sort it out
e|sort it out.why: 문제를 해결하자는 말은 sort it out이에요.
e|sort it out.line: Let’s sort it out after lunch.

e|so far.name: so far
e|so far.why: 지금까지를 가리킬 때는 So far를 써요.
e|so far.line: So far, the weather has been nice.

e|just in case.name: just in case
e|just in case.gloss: 비가 올 경우를 대비해서 우산을 가져가.
e|just in case.why: 혹시 모를 일에 대비한다는 말은 just in case예요.
e|just in case.line: Take an umbrella just in case it rains.

e|that makes sense.name: that makes sense
e|that makes sense.why: 이해가 된다는 말은 that makes sense예요.
e|that makes sense.line: Oh, that makes sense, thanks for explaining.

e|fair enough.name: fair enough
e|fair enough.gloss: 오늘 밤에 올 수 없다고? 알겠어.
e|fair enough.why: 상대의 사정을 받아들인다는 대답은 Fair enough예요.
e|fair enough.line: You can’t come tonight? Fair enough.

e|get back to me.name: get back to me
e|get back to me.why: 나중에 다시 연락해 달라는 말은 get back to me예요.
e|get back to me.line: If you know the answer, get back to me.
